saw.short: Asda's £30-off deal becomes a half-price video game hack
saw.headline: Asda's £30-off deal becomes a *half-price game hack*
saw.what: Asda offered £30 off a £60+ shop to first-time online customers who sign up to marketing emails. It worked on electronics, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 at half price. Asda has paused the offer after “a significant number of orders that do not qualify”.
saw.why: Promo terms get tested in public within days, and receipts and how-to videos become the content.

saw.short: Taylor Swift says she's been “estranged” from Brad Paisley since 2007
saw.headline: Taylor Swift says she's been *“estranged”* from Brad Paisley
saw.what: At Monday's Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame gala, Taylor Swift told Brad Paisley, who was inducting her, they'd been “estranged since 2007”. His tour prank: “Filled my entire tour bus with live crickets. Thousands of them.” Then: “bygones be bygones.”
saw.why: A prank confession with a clean ending is easy to share. The joke needs no context.

saw.short: Wendy's lists a free retro RPG on Steam
saw.headline: Wendy's lists a *free retro RPG* on Steam
saw.what: Dexerto reports Wendy's is behind “WendyQuest”, a free pixel-art RPG with enemies called “Big Mech” and “Golden Archers”. Its Steam page, from developer 81monkeys, says “coming soon” with no date. Dexerto reads it as a jab at McDonald's.
saw.why: A brand turns a rivalry into a game, and the wishlist page is the content for now.

saw.short: Big Brother's Tiffany Pollard enters the house
saw.headline: Big Brother's *Tiffany Pollard* enters the house
saw.what: Big Brother's official post read: “The HBIC is in town! Tiffany Pollard has entered the Big Brother House. Break a leg.” She first appeared on Celebrity Big Brother in 2016, finishing fourth, per Digital Spy. She joins as a guest housemate.
saw.why: A cult favourite returning gives fans something to predict, and the official account led the announcement.

platform.short: Discord will put public server messages into Google
platform.headline: Discord will put *public server messages* into Google
platform.what: From 16 Nov, Discord will create public web pages for big “Discoverable Servers”. From mid-December, messages in eligible public channels may appear there and in search. In the UK a user setting is off by default, so messages show only if people opt in.
platform.why: Public community chat becomes searchable. Brands with open Discords should check what's on show.

platform.headline: Meta's Edits adds *Halloween effects*
platform.what: Edits added Halloween fonts, sound effects and animations, 13 new text animations, beat-synced effects and new caption styles. The carousel editor is now on Android too. The article doesn't say where each feature is available.
platform.why: Ready-made Halloween tools for Reels this week. Check UK availability before planning on them.

platform.short: TikTok pushes TopView and Pulse Suite for the holidays
platform.headline: TikTok pushes *TopView and Pulse Suite* for the holidays
platform.what: TikTok published a 12-page guide for holiday campaigns, built around TopView, the first feed placement of the day, and Pulse Suite. It covers seasonal trends and engagement around big events. It has no UK data, and Social Media Today notes these are the pricier options.
platform.why: Q4 planning is under way. Ask for UK numbers before booking premium slots.

watch.title: Instagram removes Reels series links
watch.note: The option to link Reels into a series goes, per Social Media Today. Check plans that rely on it.

watch.title: Celebrity Traitors' last two episodes
watch.note: Reported for 8pm on BBC One both nights. Keep captions spoiler-free.

watch.title: Halloween, and Strictly's Halloween special
watch.note: Costume and Halloween content peaks from Thursday. Get posts out early.

watch.title: Discord's public server pages begin
watch.note: Messages could appear in search from mid-December. UK users have to opt in.

watch.title: Meta's business terms update
watch.note: Moved from 30 Oct, per Social Media Today citing Reuters.
